description: This file is an auto-generated proxy script used by Composer to include a specific binary (jp.php) from the mtdowling/jmespath package, with compatibility considerations for PHP versions below 8.0. It sets up stream wrapper proxies to handle PHP's shebang behavior and stream operations.

classes.name: Composer inProxyWrapper
classes.description: A stream wrapper class for proxying file operations to handle PHP version compatibility and shebang removal during file inclusion.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens a stream and prepares for reading, removing shebang lines on first read.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, filtering out shebang header on first read.

methods.name: stream_lock
methods.description: Applies or releases a lock on the stream.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if end of file has been reached.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns stream status; here, returns an empty array.

methods.name: url_stat
methods.description: Returns stat info for a URL, stripping the proxy prefix.
